end.parentNote: Nisha practised finding fractions from equal groups and shapes, including 1/3, 1/4, and 2/5. They explained that halves need two equal pieces and correctly identified the flag divided into four equal sections. There was a mix-up between the total number of parts and the parts remaining; this was corrected for 2/5, though the teach-back was not yet complete. At home, use paper strips or fruit to make equal halves, thirds, and quarters, and ask Nisha to name the total equal parts and the parts chosen.
